notes.title: Last update for a little while.
notes.notes:
Things are looking pretty good with Dere-chat for the moment so I'll be moving back to working on Wifu-Box for a little while. Do let me know if there is anything you'd like to see added to the game or if you spot any other bugs I've missed! 

this update includes:
[list]
[*]Click text while it's still going finishes it instead of skipping to the next dialogue.
[*]Back button is working (it wont be available if a player or wifu has made a decision) 
[*]Added a "Factory reset" to the title settings page. 
[/list]
Thank you again everyone who has joined us for this wild-ride. It has truly been an amazing experience releasing my first solo-game on steam and I hope you're as excited for the future of Wifu-Box as I am! 
Keep on keeping on! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: DERE-CHAT public release date announcement!
notes.notes:
I'm so very excited to publicly announce the very first title in the Wifu-Box series will be dropping on May 5th (or 6th of May if you're with me in the Asia-pacific timezones)!

This visual novel-style game introduces Dere-chan, one of the five main characters in the Waifu-Sim game I'm developing. The idea for this game is to try and flesh out ideas for the characters and to try and get some real commercial feedback/practice as a game developer.

Again, thank you so much everyone for your support and encouragement. This is my first solo game project I've released so I'm sorry if it's a little bumpy at the start but I'm 100% sure that with your support the future of Wifu-Box is going to be bright indeed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291149/278cc045885ae13799534dca64d28011ffc7b800.png[/img]

And for anybody who missed the event cards this will be your [i][b]last chance to collect the special outfit unlock codes![/b][/i] No really, after this you'll have to wait a whole year to save them again (or just message me, I'm not stingy..).

Oh and lastly Linux support [i][b]IS COMMING![/b][/i] Though it may not be in time for the main release day it won't be far behind! 

Happy headpetting everybody! <3
